description: This file defines the `ParserDropDown` class which extends `ModuleBuilderParser`. It handles the processing, synchronization, and updating of dropdown list definitions within SuiteCRM/ModuleBuilder, including saving dropdowns, ensuring consistency across languages and modules, and generating PHP code for list strings.

classes.name: ParserDropDown
classes.description: Handles dropdown list processing, synchronization across languages and modules, and code generation for dropdown list definitions.

methods.name: saveDropDown
methods.description: Processes input parameters to save or update a dropdown list in various contexts (studio or module builder), handles decoding, encoding, and file updates.

methods.name: synchDropDown
methods.description: Ensures that dropdown keys are consistent across all language files.

methods.name: synchMBDropDown
methods.description: Synchronizes dropdown keys across all languages used in a ModuleBuilder module.

methods.name: synchDDKeys
methods.description: Helper function to reconcile keys between two arrays representing dropdown options.

methods.name: getPatternMatchGlobal
methods.description: Generates regex pattern to match global list string definitions in PHP files.

methods.name: getPatternMatch
methods.description: Generates regex pattern to match specific list string definitions in PHP files.

methods.name: getNewCustomContents
methods.description: Generates new PHP file contents with updated dropdown list definitions.
